mentions.name: Anna
mentions.description: This is an AI emotional regulation coach for autism. Traditional therapy assumes users can identify what they're feeling, which many autistic people struggle with; Anna addresses this dilemma. The author has used it daily for nearly a year without a major dysregulation event and is now developing it further, with a detailed framework published for building your own.
mentions.problem: Traditional therapy assumes you can identify what you're feeling, which is exactly what many autistic people struggle with.
mentions.audience: Autistic people who struggle with identifying what they are feeling.
